title: Reconcile source-only half-damage obligations with clause IR
description: The finding registry now snapshots every matching half-damage branch in the committed pack and keeps durable expected identities separate from current readiness. The source audit title describes omitted creature and hazard branches that cannot be enumerated from the defective projection alone. Once clause/source IR is available, reconcile the source obligation ledger to the committed pack and add any source-only identities with exact expected-pack joins; preserve the current generated snapshot and no-count hygiene.
acceptance_criteria: Source-side half-damage obligations are independently enumerated from authoritative source/clause IR, joined to exact pack paths, and the registry regression fails on omitted or partial membership.
notes: 2026-09-22 SUPERSEDED. Both premises are gone. (2) 'Once clause/source IR is available': the clause IR never landed. PR #475 closed unmerged, and eshyra-o9bd.19.1.1 is DESIGN_INVALIDATED. The surviving concern, that source-only half-damage branches must be enumerated from the SRD source because the pack omitted them, creature and hazard alike, is carried to eshyra-o9bd.19.4.3. That bead owns registry row half-damage-branches (opus:F-25).
close_reason: Superseded: registry v2 holds no membership and the clause IR never landed; the source-only enumeration requirement is carried to eshyra-o9bd.19.4.3, the owner of opus:F-25.
